question.text: Category III AIFs register with the US IRS to obtain which identifier under FATCA?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.20, Cat III AIFs register with US IRS to obtain a Global Intermediary Identification Number (GIIN). The Trap: LEI is legal-entity identifier (separate), SWIFT BIC is banking, PAN is Indian tax ID. Cross-Exam Context: Same registration applies to all Indian RFIs under FATCA.
